odyn.title: Initiatives
odyn.description: Group related chats and documents under one goal. Linked chats start with a short summary, and agents keep the documents up to date.
odyn.author: Odyn

commands.name: suggest-link
commands.title: Suggest linking this chat
commands.description: Ask the person whether this chat belongs to an initiative. Shows a card with 'Not now' and 'Link chat'; nothing is linked unless they click. Use when the work clearly fits an existing initiative and the chat is not linked yet.

inputs.name: initiativeId
inputs.description: The initiative to suggest.

commands.name: list-initiatives
commands.title: List initiatives
commands.description: List this project's initiatives: id, title, status and how many documents. Check here before creating a new one.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Words to look for in titles and descriptions.

commands.name: read-initiative
commands.title: Read initiative
commands.description: Read an initiative's index: its groups and documents with titles, descriptions and sizes, never their bodies.

inputs.name: initiativeId
inputs.description: The initiative. Leave out for the one this chat is linked to.

commands.name: read-document
commands.title: Read document
commands.description: Read one document or note as markdown. Use `outline` first for long ones, then read a `section`.

inputs.name: noteId
inputs.description: The document or note id.

inputs.name: section
inputs.description: A heading, or a path of headings joined by ">", to read just that part.

inputs.name: outline
inputs.description: Return only the headings with their sizes.

commands.name: list-notes
commands.title: List notes
commands.description: List this project's notes and documents, newest first.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: How many to list.

commands.name: create-initiative
commands.title: Create initiative
commands.description: Create an initiative: a folder of documents for one piece of work. It is not linked to this chat; use suggest-link to ask.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Short title.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: One line on what it is for.

commands.name: create-document
commands.title: Create document
commands.description: Write a new document into an initiative, or a loose note with `loose`.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Short title.

inputs.name: markdown
inputs.description: The body, in markdown.

inputs.name: initiativeId
inputs.description: The initiative. Leave out for the one this chat is linked to.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: One line on what it holds.

inputs.name: group
inputs.description: The group to put it in; left out, the active group.

inputs.name: loose
inputs.description: Write a loose note in no initiative.

commands.name: edit-document
commands.title: Replace document
commands.description: Replace a whole document with new markdown. Prefer patch-document for small changes.

inputs.name: noteId
inputs.description: The document or note id.

inputs.name: markdown
inputs.description: The new body.

commands.name: patch-document
commands.title: Patch document
commands.description: Change parts of a document without rewriting it.

inputs.name: noteId
inputs.description: The document or note id.

inputs.name: edits
inputs.description: JSON list of edits, each {"op":"replace_text","old_text","new_text"} | {"op":"append","section","text"} | {"op":"replace_section","section","text"} | {"op":"tick","task","done"} | {"op":"set","property","value"}.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: The version read-document returned, to refuse the change if someone edited it since.

commands.name: rename-document
commands.title: Rename document
commands.description: Give a document or note a new title.

inputs.name: noteId
inputs.description: The document or note id.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: The new title.

commands.name: delete-document
commands.title: Delete document
commands.description: Delete a document or note. Only when the person asked for it.

inputs.name: noteId
inputs.description: The document or note id.

commands.name: move-notes
commands.title: Move notes into initiative
commands.description: Move loose notes into an initiative.

inputs.name: noteIds
inputs.description: Note ids, separated by commas.

inputs.name: initiativeId
inputs.description: The initiative. Leave out for the one this chat is linked to.

inputs.name: makePrivate
inputs.description: Confirmed by the person: make shared notes private so they can move.

inputs.name: group
inputs.description: The group to put them in.

commands.name: mark-complete
commands.title: Mark initiative complete
commands.description: Mark an initiative as finished, with a one-line summary of what shipped.

inputs.name: initiativeId
inputs.description: The initiative. Leave out for the one this chat is linked to.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: What was done, in one line.

commands.name: edit-groups
commands.title: Edit initiative groups
commands.description: Create, rename, reorder, finish, delete or restore an initiative's groups.

inputs.name: initiativeId
inputs.description: The initiative. Leave out for the one this chat is linked to.

inputs.name: changes
inputs.description: JSON object with any of: create [{name, active?}], rename [{group, to}], delete [names], restore [names], order [names], setActive name|null, setDone [{group, done}].

agent.summary: Initiatives: read and update the initiative this chat is linked to, its documents and the project's loose notes, and suggest linking a chat to an initiative.
